about: Progress (docs/engine.md, "Progress"; P5.11): each enrollment's readings by state, the seven dates ending today with whether the reader read and whether each was a reading day, coverage across all enrollments with each verse once, and the streak. The plans are invented.

cases.name: nothing marked: every reading unread, nothing covered, no streak
streak: read Thursday, Friday and Monday; on Tuesday morning it is 3, the weekend being rest days
streak: today counts once it is read
streak: a reading day with no reading ends it
streak: it counts back to the missed day and no further
streak: reading on a rest day adds nothing to it, and the day shows as read
streak: paused days neither break it nor add to it
streak: a reading on a paused day adds nothing, and the pause still does not break it
a skip is not a reading: the day is not read, and the streak ends there
marked read and then skipped with no undo: the slot is skipped and covers nothing; the day stays a day read until the reading is undone
an undone reading is unread again: nothing read, nothing covered
late logging: a reading logged for an earlier day is that day's
part read with no verses stated: no verses, the chapter partial, the book explored
part read with verses stated: those verses, and the chapter partial
part read with verses beyond the reading: only the reading's own verses count
part read with verses that are none of the reading's: as if none were stated
part read with verses that are not a reading: as if none were stated
part read twice: the later mark is the slot's, with its verses, and both days are days read
part read one day and read the next: the whole reading is covered, and both days are days read
two enrollments: repeats add nothing to coverage, and plan completion is counted apart
two enrollments: a reading day of either is a reading day, so a missed Thursday ends the streak
an ended enrollment's reading days no longer weigh on the streak; what was read in it stays read
a finished sequence asks nothing after its last marked day: the streak stands
a finished plan and a new one: the streak runs on across the days between
before the start: no reading days yet
a change of reading days counts from its date: Saturday is now a reading day, Sunday a rest day
calendar: the total is the slots appointed from the start to today; April's 31st is not one
calendar: paused days are not in the total, but a slot read on one is
calendar: an ended enrollment's total stops at the day it ended
calendar: the same reading in two months is two slots read and is covered once
calendar: a slot read ahead is in the total
calendar: February appoints 28 readings; the streak runs across the month's end
